description: Feature 3.6 optimization decision log — evidence-driven, no code change without justification
rule: No code modification just to produce a diff. If implementation already optimal → ALREADY_OPTIMIZED with evidence. Decisions must reference baseline evidence.

decisions.baseline_evidence: feature_3_6_model_load_baseline.json — eager load in lifespan (api.py:47-51), PipelineLoader._pipeline singleton, 1 load per backend lifecycle, 0 reloads during requests
decisions.root_cause: None — no reload detected. Model is loaded once at application startup and shared read-only.
decisions.decision_reason: Feature 3.2 already loads model once per process in lifespan and caches in a singleton. Per spec section 5: do not swap to a custom complex singleton. Do not create frontend model cache. No change.

decisions.candidate: Static metadata caching (schemas, selected_features, model/data/package version JSON)
decisions.baseline_evidence: feature_3_6_artifact_read_baseline.json — input_schema, selected_features, metadata JSONs each read 1x per lifecycle, cached in PipelineLoader (_schemas, _selected_features, _metadata)
decisions.root_cause: None — already memoized in PipelineLoader on first access
decisions.decision_reason: All three metadata groups load once per process and are cached. No repeated disk read. No change.

decisions.baseline_evidence: feature_3_6_artifact_read_baseline.json — api.py:127-141 reads model_metrics.json from disk on every /model-info request; not cached
decisions.root_cause: /model-info handler opens the metrics JSON per request instead of reusing PipelineLoader's metadata cache
decisions.proposed_change: Load model_metrics.json once (lazy, into PipelineLoader._metadata) and reuse
decisions.expected_effect: Removes one small disk read per /model-info
decisions.risk: Low — but requires a live benchmark to demonstrate the read is significant; file is a few KB, read is microseconds
decisions.decision_reason: Per spec section 12, metadata caching is justified only if 'baseline cho thấy đáng kể'. No live baseline exists (Phase 1 BLOCKED). File size is tiny; measured impact cannot be established. Adding a code change without MEASURE evidence would violate the methodology. Re-evaluate after live baseline. Recorded as documented observation.

decisions.baseline_evidence: feature_3_6_dashboard_load_baseline.json — pages/4_Trends.py load_yearly_features(path) is @st.cache_data (path-keyed); Feature 3.4 dashboard_cache.load_trend_dataset_cached is st.cache_data (SHA-256-keyed)
decisions.root_cause: None for caching — both layers use st.cache_data; the 169,681-row CSV is not re-read on warm reruns
decisions.decision_reason: Dashboard data is already cached with st.cache_data. The page in use keys by path; Feature 3.4 layer keys by SHA-256. Caching is correct for an immutable demo dataset. No change.

decisions.baseline_evidence: feature_3_6_dashboard_load_baseline.json — dashboard_cache.make_agg_cache_key encodes (version, feature, method, granularity, year bounds); aggregation results cached; page-level aggregation computed once then st.cache_data-cached
decisions.root_cause: None for caching — aggregation runs once per session then cached
decisions.decision_reason: Aggregations are cached with parameter-aware keys. No repeated recomputation on warm reruns. No change.

note_OPT_003: model_metrics.json per-request read remains a documented observation (LOW). Re-evaluate after a live baseline exists.
observation_aggregation: pages/4_Trends.py load_yearly_features aggregates 169,681 rows with a pure-Python loop (csv module, per-row dict math) — not pandas vectorized. Cold page load likely expensive (cached after first run). This is an aggregation-IMPLEMENTATION note, out of Phase 2 caching scope, and not a listed WBS task; do not change without live measurement and Feature 3.4 aggregate-value regression check.
